title: Thu 26 Nov · morning check
summary:
[b]Overnight:[/b] Wall Street recovered most of a 3% slide (S&P 500 −0.25%, VIX ~28); Fed December hike still ~97%; BoJ's Tamura wants rates at neutral 'soon' (no December pledge); Australia Q3 capex +12.2% vs 4.4%; Brent +3.5% on a Houthi refinery claim. No published score changes; 3 pairs under pressure, 12 under watch.
[b]Next:[/b] Thu 26 Nov US Thanksgiving, French CMP (time n/v), ECB accounts 14:30; Fri 27 Nov Tokyo CPI 01:30, France GDP 09:45, NZ election result, US half-day.

USD.note: Fed still ~97% for December, January ~63%; Beige Book growth in 8 of 12 districts; R3 +2 shadow carried (raw 7.65, held at +7).

EUR.note: French PLFSS joint committee and ECB accounts today; no scored input overnight.

GBP.note: Carried from Greene/Mann; Bailey hinted inflation may peak lower if energy settles (single report); shadow +3 if R2 +1.

JPY.note: Tamura: reach neutral (~2%) 'soon', no explicit December pledge; shadow +2 if R2 0, −3 with the tariff scenario.

CHF.note: VIX closed near 28 after topping 30 intraday: neither the 30 nor the 25 line met on a close; tariff scenario −1.

CAD.note: Brent +3.5% to ~$94.61 on a Houthi refinery claim (N1 information only); no written loonie trigger met.

AUD.note: Carried (CPI); Q3 capex +12.2% vs 4.4% expected adds to the data line; RBA still silent; shadow +4 if R2 +1.

NZD.note: Carried from the Q3 retail beat; no NZ news overnight; official election result Friday.

XAU.note: 10-year down to ~4.80% in Asia (real-yield relief, information); gold closes conflict; G +1 unchanged.
